reconstruction_notes: Reference-led original geometry; FHSU sa_fp_009_006 specimen observed directly; no source images or model meshes incorporated.
4.3 m total length is an artistic nominal adult scale, not a measured scan. Flesh width, soft margins and palette are artistic.
Short deep head, robust lower jaw and upturned near-closed mouth; no tarpon-like protruding chin.
Seven fins: one dorsal, one anal, two pectoral, two pelvic, one deep-fork caudal. No adipose fin, second dorsal or swallowed prey.
Thesis Figures 1–2 are Megalops comparison specimens, explicitly excluded from Xiphactinus skull geometry.
Mouth nearly closed; no exposed dentition and no claimed tooth count.
Fine surface cell relief is a connected stylization, not literal count or ganoid armor.
Fin midsurfaces explicitly triangulated before thickening along a true local normal; front/back connectivity identical.
